title: Mossbrawl – a cozy forest brawler you can play in your browser (free demo)
author: tooavg
selftext:
Hey! I made a small 2D brawler that mixes Brawlhalla-style melee combat with a Helmet Heroes-style loot grind.



\- 5 hand-painted forest maps, from Sunny Meadow to Treetop Canopy

\- 7 melee weapons that each play differently (sword combos, chargeable hammer, spear tip hits, a chain hook that pulls enemies in…)

\- Loot that glows brighter the rarer it is, plus a talent tree

\- A riverside village with a shop and a bank

\- 3 lives per run. Lose them all and you drop everything you carry and start over from level 1. Only the bank keeps your stuff safe.

\- A boss waiting at the top of the canopy



Play free in the browser: [https://vestom.itch.io/mossbrawl](https://vestom.itch.io/mossbrawl)



It's a demo, so I'd really love feedback: does the combat feel good, and where did you get stuck or bored?
